description.html: This 40x25x27 cm aquarium (27 L) offers enough room for a layout with live plants, roots and stone. The glass is precisely cut and bonded with aquarium silicone, which makes it fully watertight.

The volume suits a variety of freshwater communities, from guppies and mollies to tetras, corydoras and smaller gourami species. An aquascape with live plants and a natural substrate of quartz sand or gravel completes the look.
You can order any aquarium in custom dimensions and with extra options such as openings for equipment or reinforced glass. Handmade in Novi Sad, delivered to your address.
